gloss: private lodging; bed and breakfast; guesthouse

definitions.gloss: private lodging; bed and breakfast; guesthouse
definitions.explanation: a small, family-run accommodation, often in rural or tourist areas, typically offering meals

examples.japanese: {民宿|みんしゅく}に{泊|と}まる。
{海辺|うみべ}の{民宿|みんしゅく}を{予約|よやく}した。
{民宿|みんしゅく}の{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}は{地元|じもと}の{食材|しょくざい}を{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: The breakfast at the guesthouse uses local ingredients.

examples.japanese: ホテルより{民宿|みんしゅく}の{方|ほう}が{安|やす}い。
{民宿|みんしゅく}の{女将|おかみ}さんがとても{親切|しんせつ}だった。
examples.english: The hostess at the guesthouse was very kind.

notes:
CHARACTERISTICS:
- Family-run accommodation
- Often includes meals ({朝食|ちょうしょく}・{夕食|ゆうしょく})
- More affordable than hotels
- Common in rural, mountain, or seaside areas
- Warm, homey atmosphere

RELATED ACCOMMODATION TYPES:
- {旅館|りょかん} (traditional Japanese inn - more formal)
- ペンション (pension - Western-style B&B)
- ゲストハウス (guesthouse - modern dormitory-style)
- ホテル (hotel)
- {宿|やど} (inn, lodging - general term)

MEAL OPTIONS:
- {素泊|すどま}まり (accommodation only, no meals)
- {一泊二食|いっぱくにしょく} (one night, two meals)
- {一泊朝食付|いっぱくちょうしょくつ}き (one night with breakfast)
